summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting two routine items. First, under Item 3.02, it disclosed the unregistered sale of 4,023,007 Class I shares to feeder vehicles for gross proceeds of approximately $43.0 million at NAV per share as of May 31, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or S. Second, under Item 8.01, it announced its NAV per share as of May 31, 2026, ranging from $10.4819 to $10.7109 per class, along with a detailed NAV calculation. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews are described; the filing is a standard periodic disclosure of equity sales and NAV.
